readBy: primary annotator, from the enacted article text alone
blindTo: the article's non-statutory attraction rate, its citation rank, and every judgment that cites it. The sheet showed instrument, article number and text; nothing else.
frame: the 130 articles cited in the court's reasons in at least 30 judgments and carried in the corpus registry; 4 are empty in the registry and are excluded, leaving 126
contamination: 26 of the 126 carry ratePreviouslySeen=true: their attraction rate was printed in an earlier session or in an exploratory probe of this one, before this classification was made. Every test below is reported twice, once on all 126 and once on the 100 unseen articles. The marker «العرف» entered EXTERNAL_REFERRAL after art. 164 had been read, which is the single most contaminated decision in the scheme.

classes.EXTERNAL_REFERRAL: the article's own words send the judge to a source outside the enacted text -- the Shariah, custom, or the fiqh maxims
classes.OPEN_TEXTURED_STANDARD: the decision the article calls for turns on a standard whose content the text does not fix
classes.DUTY_OR_POWER_WITHOUT_DECISION_RULE: confers a power or imposes an act without stating the rule that decides entitlement
classes.INSTITUTIONAL_DIRECTIVE: fixes an institutional fact -- competence, venue, form, deadline, chamber -- completely
classes.DEFINITION_STATUS: defines a term or fixes a scope or a status
classes.SELF_SUFFICIENT_RULE: states condition, rule and legal effect determinately enough to decide the point it addresses
